login.title: Sign in
login.invalidCredentials: Invalid email or password. After 3 wrong attempts, we send an email to the account.
login.unavailable: We could not sign you in right now. Try again in a moment.
login.sessionExpired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
login.emailNotVerified: Confirm your email before signing in. We can send you a new confirmation link.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot my password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email to receive a reset link.
forgotPassword.sent: If the email is registered, we will send a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.unavailable: We could not send it right now. Try again in a moment.

resetPassword.title: Create a new password
resetPassword.weak: The password must have at least 8 characters.
resetPassword.invalidLink: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used.
resetPassword.unavailable: We could not save it right now. Try again in a moment.
resetPassword.success: Password changed. Sign in with the new password.

signUp.title: Create account
signUp.name: Name
signUp.haveAccount: Already have an account? Sign in
signUp.tooMany: Too many sign-ups from this network. Try again later.
signUp.unavailable: We could not create the account right now. Try again in a moment.

checkEmail.title: Check your email
checkEmail.description: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Follow it to finish the sign-up. It is valid for 24 hours.

resendVerification.description: Enter your email to receive a new confirmation link.
resendVerification.sent: If the account still needs confirmation, we sent a new link.
resendVerification.unavailable: We could not send it right now. Try again in a moment.

verifyEmail.title: Email confirmation
verifyEmail.success: Email confirmed. You can now sign in.
verifyEmail.invalidLink: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one below.
verifyEmail.unavailable: We could not confirm it right now. Try again in a moment.

social.checkEmail: We sent a link to the email of your Facebook account. Follow it to finish signing in. It is valid for 24 hours.

errors.cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled. You can try again or use another option.
errors.email_required: The provider did not share a verified email. Use another option or your email and password.
errors.invalid_credentials: Invalid email or password. After 3 wrong attempts, we send an email to the account.
errors.provider_unavailable: We could not sign you in with the provider right now. If you are in another app's browser, open the page in your phone's browser or use your email and password.
errors.invalid_state: The sign-in expired or was opened in another browser. Try again.

confirmSocialLink.title: Confirm sign-in with Facebook
confirmSocialLink.question: Link the Facebook profile "{{profileName}}" to the account {{email}}?
confirmSocialLink.warning: Confirm only if you asked to sign in with this profile. If you do not recognize it, choose "This was not me".
confirmSocialLink.confirmed: Facebook linked to your account. Now just continue with Facebook.
confirmSocialLink.declined: Request declined. Nothing was linked to your account.
confirmSocialLink.invalidLink: This link is invalid, has expired or was already used. To get another one, sign in with Facebook again.
confirmSocialLink.unavailable: We could not finish it right now. Try again in a moment.
